environment.description: Same Celery worker code deployed on internal Kubernetes cluster. Split SDK is configured with the relay proxy in 'localhost mode' using a YAML definition file mounted as a ConfigMap. The targeting rules YAML specifies 'worker-verbose-logging' with treatment 'off' and a kill switch ('killed': true) which the Split SDK interprets as permanently returning the off treatment regardless of any segment evaluation or dynamic updates from Split cloud. The ConfigMap is managed by ArgoCD with a SealedSecret-protected GitOps pipeline; the flag definition cannot be changed without a merged PR to the infra repo that passes a required OPA Gatekeeper admission policy checking that no flag in the split-definitions ConfigMap has treatment set to 'on' for any key matching 'worker-*-logging'. Additionally, the Kubernetes pod security context runs the worker with a read-only root filesystem and the ConfigMap is mounted read-only at /etc/split/.

config.opa_gatekeeper_policy: deny ConfigMap where data matches 'worker-*-logging' with treatment 'on'
config.network_policy: egress denied to Split cloud API endpoints
